articles.title: China Unlikely to Fulfill 17 Billion US Ag Purchase Pledge This Year
articles.summary: China looks unlikely to fulfill a pledge to buy billions of dollars in US farm products in 2026 as leaders of the two nations prepare for their third meeting this year.
